data.split_rule: whole demos sorted sha256(20261109:episode_id); first 10% validation, separately by task/robot

rgb.resize: OpenCV INTER_AREA, RGB, no added flip; same in train/inference

data.language: frozen official CLIP-L/14 projection, exact per-episode instruction; official max_length25 padding convention
data.actions: identity canonical 7D normalized base-frame OSC delta + actual [-1,+1] gripper; base/torso0 and arm-mode-1
data.terminal: official RLDS last action repeat prior gripper and zero arm

sampling.target: task-balanced, demonstration-balanced, uniform anchor frame; identical target sequence shared by B/C
sampling.source: uniform over 3 source embodiments and 2 tasks, demonstration-balanced, uniform frame
sampling.joint: one target minibatch and one source minibatch per update; target exposure identical to matched B, twice total exposure

budgets.resource_selection: first successful actual forward/backward/optimizer step; discard probe and restart from identical seed
budgets.stop: At each tier >=96000, stop if relative reduction between means of last3 and prior3 fixed-validation metrics is <=2%; otherwise next tier, capped at768000. B/C architecture pairs extend together until both plateau or cap.
budgets.selection: final checkpoint at common stopped tier, never final test; validation diagnoses convergence and determines predeclared extension only
budgets.source_only: same rule using source validation only, zero target demos/validation
budgets.metrics: BC fixed-seed expected-action MSE and NLL separately; DP fixed-noise denoising MSE
budgets.unconverged_at_cap: report BUDGET_LIMITED_NOT_CONVERGED, do not declare algorithm intrinsically worse

algorithms.diffusion_policy: official robomimic port, UNet[256,512,1024], obs2/action8/pred16, EMA.75, 100 training noise steps, 10-step DDIM inference

optimizer.bc_transformer: AdamW1e-4, wd.01 constant; declared fixed-step schedule deviation
optimizer.diffusion_policy: AdamW1e-4 wd1e-6, cosine to cap, warmup500; upstream scheduler/EMA

legacy_barx: Reuse immutable source/LoRA weights; full100 target exposure and 224px preprocessing differ from new 90/10-128px models; separate legacy setting, not matched-data causal ranking
